Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.06.26.9:

- Fixed: Add Row on the DSPM + FDC Agent tabs of the OS / Browser Support Matrix did nothing — the FDC matrix was being stripped before reaching the page, so edits never persisted. FDC rows (Windows / macOS / VDI / Office Versions / Critical Notes) now add and save correctly.
- Previously: wider Product Lifecycle sidebar with wrapping product names.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
